description: HAL-built Gnat E232 (c.1965 production) pole-mounted in banking attitude beside the Diamond Jubilee memorial opposite the Kalaikunda ATC tower, paired with Ajeet DJ1992; originally the pair stood vertically on their tailpipes (until c.2005). Bharat-rakshak: 23 Sqn (1965), preserved near ATC Kalaikunda. Source warbirds.in (Simon Watson, Sanjay Simha photos).

Ajeet wearing the false serial DJ-1992 (Diamond Jubilee 1992), true identity unknown (possibly E1992, unverified), pole-mounted at the ATC-tower memorial at Kalaikunda with Gnat E232. Serial recorded is the painted marking only. Source warbirds.in.
aliases: DJ-1992; Gnat II; Kalaikunda ATC Ajeet

description: Ajeet E1956 of No.2 Sqn Winged Daggers (2 painted on rudder) displayed on stands outside the No.2 Sqn hangar at Kalaikunda, natural-metal finish, no engine or seat. Source warbirds.in (Sanjay Simha photos), bharat-rakshak (preserved outside 2 Sqn hangar).

Hunter F.56 on a rectangular platform outside the No.18 Sqn hangar at Kalaikunda, now overall grey; an older photo (Polly Singh) shows the serial BA-207; earlier misreported as A-968. Bharat-rakshak lists the same display as BA-307 (delivered 8 May 1959) so the identity has a one-digit discrepancy between sources. Source warbirds.in, bharat-rakshak.

Unidentified Hunter displayed as gate guardian at the Kalaikunda station entrance, with drop tanks; identity unknown. A further Hunter is reported in the station Diamond Jubilee Museum and derelict Hunter airframes lie around the airfield. Source warbirds.in Kalaikunda overview (2008).

Two-seat MiG-25RU trainer DS362, one of two IAF examples, brought from Bareilly after the 2006 MiG-25 phase-out and displayed near the main apron at Kalaikunda, repainted grey with no original markings; photographed during an Indo-Singapore exercise. Bharat-rakshak: preserved AFS Kalaikunda. Sister DS361 is at AFA Dundigal. warbirds.in (2022) states the Bharat Rakshak locations for DS361/DS362 are swapped and places DS362 at AFA Dundigal; this Kalaikunda airframe is therefore recorded as DS361, with DS362 kept as an alias pending a photo of the data plate.
aliases: MiG25U; DS-362; MiG-25U; MiG25; MiG25RU; DS362; DS-361; DS361
